name: @singularity/plugin-infra-deps-rust
description: The rust installer kind of infra/deps, on top of the build kind: cargoBuild({ crate, bin }) (its deps barrel) builds a plugin's rust/ crate with cargo build --release --locked under the mise-pinned toolchain into a shared cargo target dir (the cargo-target cache data dir), its identity every crate file plus rustc -vV; cargoBinary(ready) is the built binary. Bans spawning cargo outside it (rust/no-bare-cargo). Its cargo-updater sub-plugin keeps every rust/ crate's Cargo.lock current.
